description: This file contains utility functions for handling sharded tensors and distributed tensor operations in PyTorch, including creating sharded tensors, device string formatting, and tensor gathering across devices.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard of a tensor in a distributed setting.

classes.name: ShardedTensor
classes.description: Represents a tensor distributed across multiple devices with metadata.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing the shards of a ShardedTensor.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Properties of a tensor such as dtype, layout, and memory format.

classes.name: ShardMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for individual shards including offsets, sizes, and placement.

classes.name: DeviceMesh
classes.description: Represents a mesh of devices for distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: DTensor
classes.description: Distributed tensor abstraction supporting sharding and redistribution.

classes.name: Replicate
classes.description: Placement indicating tensor replication across devices.

classes.name: DShard
classes.description: Placement indicating a shard of a tensor on a specific device.

methods.name: _get_remote_device_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing the remote device based on rank, device type, and number of devices per node.

methods.name: _create_chunk_sharded_tensor
methods.description: Creates a ShardedTensor by partitioning a tensor into chunks along the first dimension.

methods.name: _create_chunk_dtensor
methods.description: Creates a DTensor by sharding a tensor along the first dimension and assigning device mesh placements.

methods.name: _all_gather_dtensor
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation on a DTensor and returns the local tensor.
